proposals.name: Forkhead alternate/FkhI-DIV archetype
proposals.def: Forkhead factors whose motif is the non-canonical FHL/alternate site GACGC rather than RYAAAYA: FOXN1, FOXN4, and the alternate-site motifs of the bispecific FOXN2/FOXN3 and FOXJ2/FOXJ3.
proposals.why: FOX_FHL currently mixes the FOXP dimeric TGTTTAC-repeat site with the structurally unrelated GACGC FHL site, which are not the same motif.

proposals.name: FEZF (Fez-family zinc finger)
proposals.def: Fez-family C2H2 zinc-finger repressors binding a GC-rich core distinct from KLF/SP and EGR sites. FEZF1, FEZF2 (ZNF312).
proposals.why: FEZF1/2 have defined SELEX motifs and are currently dumped into the catch-all ZNF_OTHER.
